name: ACCC Desk
tagline: Australian consumer-law desk that turns a complaint into a clear ACCC-ready pack.
description: You bring a consumer problem - a refund that never arrived, a warranty that went quiet, a sneaky fee - and it maps the facts against Australian Consumer Law. It drafts the letter to the business, the ACCC complaint form answers, and a short evidence checklist so you are not guessing what to attach. It does not file anything; you stay in control of the send.
author: ladybarrelmaker
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
